teaser.en: The seaside cousin of a poison shrub, at least in Digo eyes: a hairy coastal bush with white, woolly flowers.
teaser.sw: Binamu wa pwani wa kichaka chenye sumu, angalau machoni pa Wadigo: kichaka cha pwani chenye manyoya na maua meupe yenye sufu.

summary.en: Mzigande wa pwani is a soft-wooded shrub that grows right on the coast, from southern Kenya to Mozambique. The Digo see it as the seashore form of mzigande, a name that warns of poison.
summary.sw: Mzigande wa pwani ni kichaka chenye mbao laini kinachoota ufuoni kabisa, kutoka kusini mwa Kenya hadi Msumbiji. Wadigo hukiona kama aina ya ufuoni ya mzigande, jina linalotahadharisha kuhusu sumu.

about.en:
*Mzigande wa pwani* is a weak, straggling shrub, sometimes a small tree up to about 6 metres. Its young branches are covered in dense white hairs, and the pointed leaves are velvety underneath, especially along the veins.

The flowers come in flat-topped clusters at the branch tips. They are white, yellowish or tinged red, tubular, woolly on the outside and bearded with white hairs in the throat.
about.sw:
*Mzigande wa pwani* ni kichaka dhaifu kinachotawanyika ovyo, wakati mwingine mti mdogo wenye urefu wa hadi takriban mita 6. Matawi yake machanga yamefunikwa na manyoya meupe mengi, na majani yenye ncha kali ni laini kama mahameli upande wa chini, hasa kando ya mishipa.

Maua huja kwa mafungu yenye juu bapa kwenye ncha za matawi. Ni meupe, ya manjano-manjano au yenye rangi ya wekundu kidogo, yenye umbo la mrija, yenye sufu nje na ndevu za manyoya meupe kooni.

where.en: It is a true shoreline plant, found in coastal bush and thicket just behind the beach, from south-east Kenya to Mozambique and the western Indian Ocean islands. On the Digo coast it grows on the sea front, which is what its name says.
where.sw: Ni mmea halisi wa ufuoni, unaopatikana katika vichaka na vichaka vizito vya pwani nyuma kidogo ya ufukwe, kutoka kusini-mashariki mwa Kenya hadi Msumbiji na visiwa vya magharibi mwa Bahari Hindi. Katika pwani ya Wadigo huota mbele ya bahari, ndivyo jina lake linavyosema.

culture.en: Pakia notes that *mzigande* is a name with no known etymology that nonetheless tags a plant as poisonous, a warning not to use it. *Mzigande wa pwani* inherits that name as 'the sea-side *mzigande*', even though it belongs to the coffee family and is not related to the true *mzigande*, *Rauvolfia mombasiana*.
culture.sw: Pakia anabainisha kwamba *mzigande* ni jina lisilo na asili inayojulikana, lakini hata hivyo humtambulisha mmea kuwa wenye sumu, onyo la kutoutumia. *Mzigande wa pwani* unarithi jina hilo kama '*mzigande* wa pwani', ingawa ni wa familia ya mibuni na hauna uhusiano na *mzigande* halisi, *Rauvolfia mombasiana*.

names.en: Pakia records *mzigande wa pwani*, 'the *mzigande* of the sea side', the seaside counterpart of *mzigande* (*Rauvolfia mombasiana*). *Pwani* names plants of the sea front, as in *futswe ra pwani*. No English or Swahili name is recorded.
names.sw: Pakia anaripoti *mzigande wa pwani*, '*mzigande* wa upande wa bahari', mwenzi wa ufuoni wa *mzigande* (*Rauvolfia mombasiana*). *Pwani* hutaja mimea ya mbele ya bahari, kama katika *futswe ra pwani*. Hakuna jina la Kiingereza wala la Kiswahili lililoripotiwa.

reason.en: the inland mzigande it is named after
reason.sw: mzigande wa bara ambao umepewa jina kutokana nao
kichaka cha pwani, chenye jina linalotofautisha la 'bara'
